title: Sharp Edge-Edit Bounds at Every Level for Leaky Positive Semidefinite Forcing
summary: This work disproves the 1-leaky positive semidefinite edge-deletion conjecture and replaces it with a sharp theorem. For every leak level $\ell$ and edge $e$, one has $|Z^+_{(\ell)}(G)-Z^+_{(\ell)}(G-e)|\le 2$. More generally, if two graphs differ only on edges with both endpoints in $S$, their parameters differ by at most $|S|$. An endpoint-sensitive refinement recovers an increase of at most one whenever some minimum set for $G-e$ contains an endpoint of $e$. Both signs are sharp for every positive leak level.
